policies.title: Ancestors over Commits for Upstream Sources
policies.description: In a CycloneDX manifest, use the .pedigree.ancestors field to define the sources instead of pedigree.commit
policies.reasoning: The pedigree.commit field does not get parsed into a package by Trustify (TPAv2) so we cannot extract it easily.

encodings.title: Sources Defined as Ancestors
encodings.description: In a CycloneDX manifest, upstream sources should be defined using pedigree.ancestors

violation_feedback.feedbackMessage: TIP == If using pedigree.commit field to define upstream sources, use the .pedigree.ancestors instead. Represent this information according to the encoding. The pedigree.commit field does not get parsed into a package by Trustify (TPAv2) so we cannot extract it easily.
